subject: How to check if a inla()-call fails...

messages.author: b453c29749de564d
messages.subject: How to check if a inla()-call fails...
parts:
Sometimes one need to check if a inla()-call succeeds or fails, like
inside another routine or in a loop. I just added a simpler way to do
this. with

r = inla(...)

check

r$ok

if this is TRUE then all is fine, otherwise its not.

Here is a simple example. The default prior for the intercept is
improper, so the second example *should* fail.

Best
H

**************


> r = inla(y ~ 1, data = data.frame(y=1))
> r$ok
[1] TRUE


> r = inla(y ~ 1, data = data.frame(y=NA))
